title: Radiant Historia
subtitle: A soldier between possible histories
summary: Radiant Historia is Atlus and Headlock's Nintendo DS role-playing game about Stocke, a soldier on the war-torn continent of Vainqueur. body: Radiant Historia is Atlus and Headlock's Nintendo DS role-playing game about Stocke, a soldier on the war-torn continent of Vainqueur. The White Chronicle gives him a way to move between alternate histories as he seeks to prevent the land's desertification. A decision can lead to another branch of events, and returning with knowledge from elsewhere can make a different outcome possible. The adventure turns time travel into an ongoing responsibility. Stocke must learn which change is needed, then find the moment at which it can still be made.

Battles use a grid on which enemies can be displaced and brought together. Attacks that move a target can set up a later blow against several opponents, making the order of actions important to the result. The player prepares a sequence rather than only choosing the strongest available command. This small spatial system gives ordinary encounters another layer of planning. A useful turn can begin by changing an enemy's position, allowing the next party member to exploit the arrangement that the first action has created.

The world map connects self-contained locations that Stocke and his companions can investigate, while the Chronicle makes earlier decisions available for reconsideration. Information acquired along one branch can remove an obstacle in the other, so exploring both histories has a practical purpose. The structure gives a familiar role-playing journey a different sense of continuity: an apparent failure may identify what still needs to be learned. Radiant Historia connects its story about possible futures to a player who can revisit the past and act on an understanding earned elsewhere.
